description: Hermes harness clone in Rust — native CLI/TUI + WASM PWA. Reuses gestalt, synapse-agentic, xavier. Scope: 100% of features across 3 waves.

features.title: Workspace foundation: git deps + CI
features.description: Root Cargo.toml with git dependencies (gestalt_core, synapse-agentic), CI workflow (fmt+clippy+test), compiling workspace skeleton.
features.notes: Merged via PR #13. git deps + CI workflow verified.

features.title: swal-core Tool trait + ToolRegistry
features.description: Platform-agnostic Tool trait (name, description, JSON-schema input, async execute) + ToolRegistry (DashMap register/list/execute). wasm32-clean: no tokio/fs/process.
features.notes: Merged via PR #15. Tool trait + ToolRegistry wasm32-clean.

features.title: swal-store Store trait + SessionStore (SQLite)
features.description: Store trait (session CRUD) + SessionStore impl on rusqlite (WAL, data/swal-agent.db). Schema: sessions + messages. Shared serde types.
features.notes: Merged via PR #14. Store trait + SessionStore rusqlite WAL.

features.title: swal-loop AgentLoop (LLM→tools→feedback)
features.description: Conversational agent loop: prompt → LLM → tool_calls → execute → feed back. Platform-agnostic core, drives gestalt ToolRegistry.

features.title: LLM providers: trait + MockProvider + synapse reuse
features.description: Provider trait (async complete), MockProvider for tests, wiring to synapse-agentic providers (OpenRouter/DeepSeek/Gemini/Grok) via path-dep.

features.title: Skills loader (2-layer cache)
features.description: Load skills from filesystem with 2-layer cache (LRU + snapshot), same patterns as Hermes skills. ~100 LOC file loader.

features.title: swal-agent CLI: run command + config
features.description: `swal-agent run "task"` executes the loop end-to-end. Config from file/env (model, provider, session dir). Session persistence wiring.

features.title: Native tools wiring (gestalt ToolRegistry)
features.description: Wire gestalt tools (shell, read, write, git) into swal-loop via gestalt_core ToolRegistry. Reuse as-is, no reimplementation.

features.title: swal-gateway: HTTP/WS + MCP server
features.description: Gateway exposes the loop remotely over HTTP/WS + MCP server. Telegram/Discord webhook→EventBus shims. External MCP client completes a task via gateway.

features.title: MCP client (rmcp) → xavier
features.description: Hermes role is MCP client: swal-loop consumes MCP tools via rmcp. Gateway exposes it, loop consumes. External MCP tools callable from loop.

features.title: swal-sched: cron ticks + subagent spawn
features.description: Tokio cron loop (~100 LOC): scheduled prompts injected into loop, spawns subagent loops. Timer-based, not system cron.

features.title: Subagents: isolated loop instances
features.description: Subagent = isolated loop instance with same registry. Native: gestalt-router worktrees. wasm: WebWorkers. Per-agent context.

features.title: Compaction on long sessions (synapse-agentic)
features.description: Context trimming via synapse-agentic compaction module when session exceeds threshold. Reuse, don't replicate.

features.title: Memory: xavier HTTP/MCP client round-trip
features.description: Session search + store round-trip via xavier HTTP/MCP. Never embed xavier — client call only.

features.title: swal-core wasm32-clean
features.description: Agent loop + tools trait compiled to wasm32 without tokio/fs/process. Async via wasm-bindgen-futures. Same codebase as native loop.

features.title: swal-tools-web: OPFS/WebContainers/isomorphic-git
features.description: Web tool impls: git→isomorphic-git (JS interop), fs→OPFS, shell→WebContainers bridge. NO subprocess tool in web.

features.title: swal-store: IndexedDB backend (rexie)
features.description: Store trait + IndexedDB impl via rexie. Same shared serde schema as native rusqlite backend. Session persistence in browser.

features.title: Leptos PWA + Comlink worker + WebLLM
features.description: PWA dashboard (Leptos, single Rust codebase → WASM) reusing swal-core types. Comlink worker runs loop + WebLLM off main thread. WebLLM in-browser inference, same OpenAI-style API.

features.title: swal-sync: CRDT sync engine → EdgeMesh/xavier
features.description: SyncEngine behind transport trait: native→EdgeMesh TCP/QUIC, web→WS/WebRTC relay. Same CRDT/merge logic. State syncs to xavier.
